$comment: Labeled discrimination set. `expected` must rank HIGH, `antiExpected` must rank LOW. Every name is validated against the live inventory before the eval runs, so a typo fails loudly instead of silently inflating a score. Adversarial cases carry no expectations: they test that a vague prompt does not produce confident hiding.

cases.note: A prompt with no content must not produce confident hiding. Measured by how much the gate hides, not by ranking.

cases.note: Ambiguous but weakly directional. Performance-ish skills ranking up is fine; hiding almost everything is not.
